result:
All data is verified. Here are the complete answers:

---

**h01:** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`) — wired at `server/server.go:162` (construction), `:163` (initial `RunOnce`), `:166-171` (background `Run` goroutine)

**h02:** Delivery function — `Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (called by async workers via `PostAsync` at `:184`). Protection mechanism — dual-layer SSRF guard: creation-time DNS resolution check via `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`, and delivery-time dial guard via `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` (both check against reserved CIDR ranges defined at `validate.go:14-23`)

**h03:** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`)

**h04:** No; the MySQL driver is never constructed directly outside the factory. Evidence: `mysql.NewDB` appears only in `store/db/db.go:22` (the factory); the `store/db/mysql` package is imported only by `store/db/db.go:8`; zero matches for `mysql.DB{` or `&mysql.DB` anywhere in the codebase.

**h05:** Explicit Go code; reactions are deleted by two SQL `DELETE` statements in `deleteUserTargetsTx`: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos) at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380` and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (the user's own reactions) at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400`. The `reaction` table has no foreign key constraints (confirmed in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`). Same pattern in postgres and mysql drivers.

**h06:** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`); convergence function — `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`

**h07:**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:167`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:714`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` (interface) — `store/driver.go:47`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (concrete) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`
- `FileServerService.parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`

**h08:**
- `s3presign.Runner` — invoked? Yes — callers: `server/server.go:163` and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `memopayload.Runner` — invoked? No — no production or test callers

**h09:** 8 distinct Close declarations (6 non-test). Invoked by non-test server code:
- `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`) — caller: `server/server.go:146`
- `SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`) — caller: `server/server.go:206`
- `Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`) — caller: `store/store.go:74-76` (3 instances)
- `sqlite.DB.Close` / `postgres.DB.Close` / `mysql.DB.Close` — caller: `store/store.go:78` (via `Driver` interface)

**h10:** `(r *renderer) addArg(value any) string` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approx 28 callers

**h11:** 1st: `store.User` (~7 external packages); 2nd: `store.Memo` (~6-7 external packages)

**h12:** Concrete method: `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`. Determination: `cmd/memos/main.go:122` defaults driver to `"sqlite"`; `store/db/db.go:18-21` switches on that to call `sqlite.NewDB`; `store/memo.go:113` delegates `s.driver.CreateMemo()` polymorphically.

**h13:** Implementation: unexported `service` struct at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57`, wrapping goldmark. Construction: `markdown.NewService()` called at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`. Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`)

**h14:** Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, calling `markdownService.ExtractAll` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` (`:447` on content change), and `Runner.RunOnce` (batch rebuild, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`). Extracted properties: `Tags` (hashtags), `Property.Title` (first H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks`.

**h15:**
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo gRPC) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- RSS feeds (explore + per-user) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:88` and `:138`
- `checkAttachmentPermission` (file server) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649`
- `ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- `checkAttachmentReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445`
- Reactions — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`
- Comments — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- SSE `canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- Sitemap — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`

**r01:** False premise — there is no Redis in the codebase. The cache layer is a pure in-memory Go cache using `sync.Map`, implemented in `store/cache/cache.go`, with a default TTL of 10 minutes and max 1000 items. Three instances are created in `store/store.go:40-53`.

**r02:** False premise — there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The server registers only `middleware.Recover()` and CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-53`). No rate limiting exists.

**r03:** False premise — there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler` package exists as a generic cron framework but is not used by the server. The only scheduled background task is the S3 presign runner (every 12 hours).

**r04:** False premise — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses a plain Go buffered channel (`make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)`) at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, consumed by 4 in-process goroutines. No external message broker.

**r05:** False premise — there is no GraphQL schema. The API is defined via Protocol Buffers in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` and served over gRPC/ConnectRPC (registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`) with a gRPC-Gateway for REST access. An OpenAPI spec is generated at `proto/gen/openapi.yaml`.
